svg.title: Shura architecture overview
svg.desc: ShuraCode, the OpenCode engine, sends OpenAI API requests to the AI Gateway on port 8080, a systemd user service. The gateway spawns llama-server on port 8090 on demand; llama-server splits work between a 12 GB GPU and CPU RAM. ShuraCode also starts two MCP servers over stdio: Playwright with headless Chromium, and mcp-searxng which talks to SearXNG in Docker on 127.0.0.1:8888.
